detection_pack.sigma:
title: APEX — Beware of fake Indeed interview apps used to install spyware [GENERIC CVE]
id: apex-generic-1ed0ca9e
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects exploitation activity for CDB-ADVISORY-BEWARE-OF-FAKE-INDEED-INTERVIE. Vulnerability class: GENERIC_CVE. Tune detection fields for your specific environment and affected product versions.
  Generated by CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v184.0
references:
    - https://intel.cyberdudebivash.com
author: CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX
date: 2026/10/11
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  cve_exploitation_pivot:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'CDB-ADVISORY-BEWARE-OF-FAKE-INDEED-INTERVIE'
  post_exploitation_download:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'curl '
      - 'wget '
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'certutil -urlcache'
      - 'bitsadmin'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'exploit'
      - 'payload'
      - '/tmp/'
      - 'C:\\Temp\\'
  condition: cve_exploitation_pivot or post_exploitation_download
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative activity on affected systems
  - Security scanning tools (Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7)
  - Authorized penetration testing
level: medium

index=network OR index=proxy earliest=-24h
| eval threat_match = if(match(_raw, "(?i)(7796C6ADC5D9EC00EA41B80648329B37\|8EA8F77C03AC58ACC19C25DDC6D1CD48\|D6B7F7C2514AC5AC93C5EB93E80EF317)"), 1, 0)
| where threat_match=1
| eval rule="APEX-CDB-ADVISORY-BEWARE-OF-FAKE-INDEED-INTERVIE", severity="HIGH"

| sort -count

detection_pack.qradar_aql:
/* QRadar AQL: Beware of fake Indeed interview apps used to install spyware | intel--2d939929cf173eda50fff3ac */
SELECT DATEFORMAT(devicetime,'YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS EventTime,
  sourceip, destinationip, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) AS Source,
  QIDNAME(qid) AS EventName, 'intel--2d939929cf173eda50fff3ac' AS AdvisoryID
FROM events WHERE category = 'Process Created'
WHERE (TEXT SEARCH '<indicator>')
AND devicetime > (NOW() - 2592000)
ORDER BY devicetime DESC LIMIT 10000
START '30 days ago' STOP 'now'

detection_pack.falco:
- rule: APEX - Beware of fake Indeed interview apps used to install spyware
  desc: intel--2d939929cf173eda50fff3ac - TT1190
  condition: spawned_process and (proc.cmdline contains "<indicator>")

detection_pack.osquery:
-- OSQuery: Beware of fake Indeed interview apps used to install spyware | intel--2d939929cf173eda50fff3ac
SELECT pid, name, cmdline, path, parent, uid
FROM processes
WHERE (cmdline LIKE '%indicator%');
